entities.summary: Wahrez was a Sasanian general of Daylamite origin, first mentioned in the prelude to the Iberian War and then during the Aksumite–Persian wars. Born around 450 CE, Wahrez rose to prominence as a skilled military commander, leading successful campaigns against the Byzantine Empire and the Kingdom of Aksum. His victories extended the Sasanian Empire's borders, solidifying its position as a dominant power in the ancient world. Wahrez's military campaigns were marked by their brutality and efficiency, earning him a reputation as a ruthless and cunning leader. Despite his military successes, Wahrez's personal life remains shrouded in mystery, with little information available about his family, relationships, or later years. His legacy, however, has endured, with historians continuing to study his tactics and strategies as a testament to the Sasanian Empire's military prowess.
